scripts.prepare:dev: npm run build --workspace @paralax/contracts && npm run db:generate
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:dev && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev --workspace @paralax/api" "npm run dev --workspace @paralax/web"
scripts.build: npm run prepare:dev && npm run build --workspace @paralax/api && npm run build --workspace @paralax/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:dev && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:api: npm run prepare:dev && npm run build --workspace @paralax/api && npm run test --workspace @paralax/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run prepare:dev && node apps/api/test/prepare-post-pioneer-fixtures.cjs && node scripts/test-e2e.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:api
